title: hestia longifolia
intro: Hestia longifolia, commonly known as Indian long pepper, is a plant species belonging to the Piperaceae family. This plant is prized for its health benefits, including its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and exhibit antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Hestia longifolia include its ability to stimulate appetite, ease respiratory issues, and act as a natural expectorant. The bioactive constituents present in Hestia longifolia include piperine, piperlonguminine, and other alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
